name: FerroFedRefusal
title: FerroFED refusal
description: The refusals a FerroFED gateway names in the details of an OperationOutcome on its FHIR face, so a national connector can map each one.

concept.display: No data for the treatment relationship's patient
concept.definition: A national contact point's request named another patient than its treatment relationship confirmation binds, reached a resource of another patient, or named a patient no member holds; the answer is the same in every case (eHDSI XCA Profile 8.0.1 §4.2.1, §4.2.2).
A national contact point's patient-data request carried no patient of a treatment relationship confirmation (eHDSI SAML Profile 10.0.0 §4.3).

A national contact point relayed an emergency access for a health professional who reached the limit of emergency accesses in the window, so the access was denied (eHDSI Section II Security Services 10.0.0 §2.5; NCPeH Architecture Specifications 10.0.0 §5.1.9).
A national contact point's request named no patient or EHR its treatment relationship confirmation binds, so nothing was sent (eHDSI XCA Profile 8.0.1 §4.2.1).
The request carried no access token the gateway accepts (§13.1, N25).
The request carried two credentials, or a credential field that is no credential (RFC 6750 §3.1).
The access token could not be verified now, because the issuer's metadata, key set or introspection endpoint could not be read.

concept.display: Scope does not grant the operation
concept.definition: No scope of the access token grants the operation.
The gateway admits no caller to the operation.
The request reached beyond the patient the access token's grant is confined to.
Only a patient grant covers the operation, and the access token names no patient context to confine it to.
The national contact point's correlation header was repeated, empty, too long, or not visible ASCII.

concept.display: Member did not answer in time
concept.definition: A member node did not answer in time (§11.2).
A member node could not be reached (§11.2).
A member node refused the gateway's onward credentials (§11.2).
A member node answered with an error (§11.2).
No reachable member is the controlling system of the version (N36).
The cross-reference service could not answer, so where the patient has an EHR is unknown (§5.2, §11.2).
The localizer could not answer, so no member was asked (§14.1, N4).
The cross-reference could not resolve the patient of a patient grant, so nothing was sent (§5.2, §11.2).

concept.display: Consent does not permit the request
concept.definition: The consent pre-filter does not permit asking the members that might hold the patient's EHR (N27a).
The gateway failed on its own side.
The access could not be recorded, so its answer was withheld.
The emergency access could not be counted against the health professional's limit, so it was refused.
